T1.detection: DoG sigma 0.6 minus 2, threshold >3; skeleton; maximal graph chains; no branch removal
T1.seed: nearest point to reference on chain >=20 px; direction toward farther endpoint from interior reference
T1.continuation: endpoints within 8 px; score .3 tangent + .25 chord + .2 proximity + .15 normal consistency + .1 ridge strength
T1.gates: score >=.72; margin >=.08 among eligible; tangent cosine >=.5; chord cosines >=.65 for nonzero gaps; normal miss <=.45 local layer spacing; no intervening skeleton crossing
T1.scope: exploratory fixed-parameter 2D geometry; no physical identity oracle; no cross-Z input
T1.gap: all nonzero connectors masked; chord length is lower bound, not true missing arc
T1.limit: 200 chains; revisits forbidden; terminal unknown one masked sample, not estimated remaining sheet length

T2.hypothesis: Maximum-recovery continuous inferred XY thread with local uncertainty and honest CT provenance
T2.input_graph: unchanged P0-T1 maximal skeleton chains; retain arc >=3px plus seed chain
T2.seed: exact P0-T1 seed, explore both directions on its parent chain
T2.target_meaning: right peripheral papyrus band, not outermost material boundary; fixed using existing CT context
T2.objective: observed arc - bridge penalty + 1.5*(initial target distance-current target distance)
T2.low_confidence: turn cosine<.7, normal miss>.45spacing, crossing proxy>0, local penalty margin<1, or within 5px of T1 suspect zone
T2.constraints: no repeated chain; no repeated observed pixel except immediate shared endpoint; no bridge crossing prior sampled geometry
T2.search: diverse beam by endpoint 12px cell/orientation quadrant, then top score fill; top3 distinct complete paths if available

provenance.3: low-confidence observed, CT sampled only if ridge-supported

T2.scope: exploratory bounded search, no claim of global optimum, no observed-percentage gate

T3.method: two-edge uncrossing: replace crossing A->B,C->D by A->C,B->D; reverse intervening edges; preserve their provenance
T3.selection: at each step choose strict decrease in proper crossing count, then minimum lost observed length, then minimum new bridge length; max20 corrections
T3.scope: only four original T2 crossings; no detection, ideal spiral, new CT, Z tracking or downstream masking
T3.gap: both replacement edges labeled2 and unsampled even if they touch bright CT
T3.uncertainty: observed edges within5px along path on either side of each new bridge relabeled3 locally
T3.amendment: Existing-archive alternatives lose31-48% observed length on three slices; loop diagnosis shows96-682px intervening arc; preserve both findings, apply local two-edge exchange instead of loop deletion

T3_contact_amendment: inclusive nonparallel contact exchange, same final run04 method
scope_override: 50 independent slices; no restriction to original five or four defects
parameters: unchanged graph, seed, target, bridge, beam, depth, scoring, max20 exchanges; historical Z146/Z160 low-confidence zones retained
failure_policy: preserve capped/unresolvable topology as negative evidence; no retuning; retain row and report defects
independence: each worker sees only its XY plane and fixed constants; no other reconstructed slice supplied; comparisons only after 50 final receipts and row hashes
coordinate: unchanged seed-relative s, no shifts/stretch/reversal during stacking
evaluation: all49 raw/difference Pearson; 256-sample windows stride128 min64 valid; 199 circular-shift controls; lag ±64 diagnostic only
